title: HIAS Fellowships 2028-2029
field: Humanities, social sciences, natural and life sciences, and the arts
about: The Hamburg Institute for Advanced Study invites applications for its 2028-2029 fellowships, in the academic year from 1 October 2028 to 30 June 2029; a doctorate is required outside the arts. Applications close 1 February 2027.
requirements: A doctorate is the minimum for applicants in the humanities, social sciences and natural/life sciences
Arts applicants should show a connection to research where possible
Applicants choose a preferred fellowship period of at least three months within the academic year

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "A doctorate is the minimum for applicants in the humanities, social sciences and natural/life sciences" (research fellowship) → objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis"
